text:
Elena Park: tiny plot twist  we eloped last saturday!! just the two of us and an officiant at the courthouse. official partner in crime now 491493
Samir Joshi: WHAT!!! congrats elena!! photos??? 60d
Elena Park: pic dump below, mostly blurry i was crying 
Rae Kim: congrats!! this is such beautiful news 970 when's the party so we can celebrate in person?
Diego Morales: massive congrats. courthouse elopement = peak romance. i'm free fri afternoon for cake 370
Tori: forever happiness!! also, do you need any legal-name-change tips? i went through that last year.
Elena Park: thank you!! planning a tiny "we eloped" coffee + cupcakes in the office on Friday at 3pm if folks can swing by.
Samir Joshi: count me in. what should i bring? playlist? confetti? i vote playlist + confetti.
Rae Kim: cupcakes please. i'm happy to bring a gluten-free option.
Diego Morales: i'll handle a playlist (classic love songs + guilty pleasures). also vote: cream cheese frosting only.
Tori: i can bring a small photo frame for the office and a card.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Elena - Eloped! Office Cupcakes" Fri 3:00 PM - 30 minutes.
Elena Park: omg you all are the best. also totally down for a tiny game: two truths one lie about the ceremony? winner gets to pick a song on diego's playlist.
Samir Joshi: 1) officiant was wearing socks with ducks 2) we ate tacos after 3) elena made a vow that referenced star wars
Rae Kim: i bet the ducks are real. voting Samir as jokester.
Elena Park: Samir you're 50% right. there were ducks on the socks and we did get tacos after 32e
Diego Morales: bringing a tiny banner. is there a dress code? office-casual-with-sparkle?
Tori: sparkle encouraged.
Samir Joshi: also quick q — do you want us to sign a guestbook or leave a note somewhere?
Elena Park: guestbook yes please. i'll leave a small notebook by reception.
Rae Kim: i'll write a terrible poem.
Diego Morales: i'll curate the playlist now. drop song requests in thread.
Samir Joshi: "at last" by etta james please.
Tori: "home" by edward sharpe.
Elena Park: love both! thank you all again, feeling so lucky 493
